content: Portability: macOS ships bash 3.2.57 — no declare -A, no ${var,,}/${var^^}, no mapfile/readarray, no negative substring offsets. BSD vs GNU: date -d @epoch (GNU) vs date -r epoch (BSD); sed -i '' vs sed -i; stat -f %m vs stat -c %Y; wc -l pads output on BSD (needs tr -d ' '). Countdown math should use pure epoch arithmetic from resets_at instead of date parsing. echo -e unreliable across shells; printf '%b' preferred (also recommended by official docs).
